questions.text: The size of the frame in the drawing does not match the prepared workpiece. What to do?

options.text: Bend the workpiece on site without approval.
Change the pitch of the rods by eye.
Assemble the frame and hide the deviation during concreting.
Stop assembly and clarify the discrepancy with the person responsible for the design documentation.

questions.text: A pack of reinforcement lies without stops on a sloping platform. What to do?

options.text: Leave the pack until the crane starts moving it.
Stop work and ensure stable storage on prepared supports with supports.
Cut the bundle banding while standing downhill from it.
Place one random scrap under the middle of the pack.

questions.text: worker holds the short rod by hand near the cutting area of ​​the machine. How to organize the operation?

options.text: Hold the rod with two people on both sides of the knife.
Put on thicker gloves and continue holding with your hand.
Use the provided feeding and holding device, keeping your hands out of the danger zone.
Increase cutting speed to finish faster.

questions.text: The unprotected ends of the rods protrude from the frame into the passage. What measure is needed?

options.text: Fence off the danger area and install the provided protection for the protruding ends or change the organization of the passage.
Paint the ends with bright paint and leave the passage open.
Cover the ends with thin paper.
Warn workers verbally without physical protection.

questions.text: When is a welded connection of reinforcement allowed?

options.text: When the rods have the same color.
When there is any welding machine on site.
When tying the reinforcement takes longer.
When it is provided for by the design and technology, and the work is performed by an approved qualified worker.

questions.text: Frame displacement was detected before concreting. What is required?

options.text: Compensate for displacement by increasing the amount of concrete.
Leave offset if reinforcement steel does not touch the formwork.
Stop preparations for concreting, restore the design position and perform inspection.
Cut interfering reinforcing bars without authorization.

questions.text: A rebar worker is working at the edge of a floor slab. Which protective measure takes priority?

options.text: Only warning sign on the floor.
Serviceable collective fencing; if necessary, supplementary fall-arrest system according to the work plan.
One safety harness without checking the anchorage point.
The presence of a colleague nearby without a fence.

questions.text: What is the correct pre-shift inspection of a rebar cutting machine?

options.text: Start with maximum load without inspection.
Check only for power supply.
First remove the guard and check the knife by hand.
Inspect guards, controls, work equipment and work area, then perform the prescribed test test.

questions.text: The frame began to shift during installation. How to proceed?

options.text: Stop the movement, exclude access to the danger zone, stabilize the frame and only then continue on command.
Go under the frame and adjust the supports.
Hold the frame with your body until the lift is completed.
Speed ​​up the movement so that the frame falls into place faster.

questions.text: What is called a protective layer of concrete?

options.text: A layer of lubricant on the surface of the rod.
Temporary film over the formwork.
Design distance from the concrete surface to the reinforcement, ensured by its correct position.
Additional row of tying wire.

questions.text: There is no approved reinforcement drawing for the detail. What should the rebar worker do?

options.text: Do not perform the unit until the approved design information and assignment have been received.
Select the diameter and pitch according to the remaining material.
Replace missing reinforcement with tying wire.
Repeat the circuit of the neighboring node regardless of the load.

questions.text: While the frame is being moved by crane, a worker moves beneath the suspended load. What must the banksman or supervisor do?

options.text: Ask the worker to hold the frame with his hands.
Immediately stop the movement and remove the person from the danger zone.
Continue ascent at lower speed.
Move the load higher without stopping the operation.

questions.text: When bending reinforcement, a colleague is in the sector of possible movement of the rod. What should I do?

options.text: Warn a colleague by shouting and start bending.
Reduce the bending angle without changing the position of the colleague.
Hold the free end of the rod with your foot.
Stop the operation and vacate the hazardous area before turning on the equipment.

questions.text: During reinforcement tying, the wire broke and its sharp end pointed toward the face. How should the risk be reduced?

options.text: Extend the end of the wire and leave it out.
Twist the wire only by hand without tools.
Use proper tools, control the direction of the wire ends and use eye and hand protection at risk.
Lean closer to see the reinforcement tying point better.

questions.text: Is it possible to replace the design coupling by welding without approval?

options.text: It is possible if the diameter of the rod is smaller than the neighboring one.
No: the connection method may be changed only through the established procedure and in accordance with the design decision.
It is possible if the welder considers the seam to be strong.
Possible for one joint without recording.

questions.text: How to install a protective layer of concrete for reinforcement?

options.text: According to the design documentation using the provided clamps and position control.
One universal size for all designs.
According to a distance that is convenient to maintain manually.
Due to the free movement of the frame during concreting.

questions.text: The frame is supplied by crane to the installation area. How to organize interaction?

options.text: Guide the load with your hands while underneath it.
Continue driving if the driver loses visibility.
Allow any worker to issue different commands.
Assign a designated signalman, use consistent commands, and keep people away from the load.

questions.text: What to check for a hand tying tool?

options.text: Only the date of the last cleaning of the workplace.
Integrity of handles, working parts, fasteners and absence of dangerous burrs.
Handle color only.
Tool weight only.

questions.text: During cutting, destruction of the machine's protective guard was discovered. What is the procedure?

options.text: Cover the area with cardboard and continue cutting.
Work only on small diameters.
Stop the machine, turn off the power, indicate the malfunction and transfer the equipment for repair.
Ask a colleague to hold a temporary shield.

questions.text: What is a mechanical coupler connection for reinforcing bars?

options.text: Random overlap of two rods without fixation.
Welding of any rods without a design solution.
Any manual reinforcement tying with wire.
A connection of reinforcing bars using a special device, made in accordance with the design and the technology of the specific system.

questions.text: At the site it is proposed to change the type of connection of the rods in order to speed up the work. Which decision is correct?

options.text: Mix different methods in one node without coordination.
Replace connections at the discretion of the contractor.
Use only the connection provided by the design and approved technology.
Use the cheapest method without control.

questions.text: Before lifting the rod bundle, damage to the sling was detected. What to do?

options.text: Do not perform the lift; replace the damaged sling with a serviceable sling inspected by the responsible person.
Reduce the load weight and use the damaged sling.
Reinforce the sling with reinforcement tying wire.
Lift the load with a jerk to reduce loading time.

questions.text: After cutting, sharp cuttings have accumulated near the machine. What to do?

options.text: Leave the trimmings until the end of the entire batch.
Stop and safely remove trimmings into designated containers using suitable equipment.
Throw cuttings into the aisle for later cleaning.
Slide the scraps under the machine with your foot.

questions.text: When installing the frame, a pinch point occurred between the frame and the formwork. How to proceed?

options.text: Stand between the frame and the formwork for precise alignment.
Hold the frame with your fingers until it is completely seated.
Do not place hands in the pinch zone and control the position of the frame using agreed means and commands.
Push the frame with your shoulder while lowering.

questions.text: What determines the correct assembly of a mechanical connection?

options.text: Only from the external shine of the coupling.
Only from manual effort.
Only from the air temperature at the beginning of the shift.
From the design solution, system compatibility, manufacturer's instructions and installed controls.

questions.text: The frame retainer was destroyed before concreting. What should I do?

options.text: Replace it with a suitable, serviceable element and re-check the stability and position of the frame.
Leave the frame without a lock if it is heavy.
Tie the frame to the formwork with random wire.
Place a random piece of wood.

questions.text: The power tool must be used in a wet area. What should I do?

options.text: Disable safety devices to avoid tripping.
Place the tool on a wet floor and plug it in via a regular extension cord.
Assess the conditions, apply the provided electrical protection and do not operate with faulty or unsuitable tools.
Wrap the tool housing in cloth and continue working.

questions.text: In what sequence is the frame assembly site prepared?

options.text: First, they lay out the rods in the passage, then look for the drawing.
Study the task, fence and clear the area, place materials securely, check tools and protection.
First, turn on the machines, then clear the work area.
First remove the guards, then select PPE.

questions.text: The lifted load is suspended above the installation area. What should I do?

options.text: Use the weight as a temporary support.
Push the load with your hands from below.
Continue tying under load while the crane is stationary.
Stop work under load, remove people and act according to the established commands of the responsible personnel.

questions.text: What are reinforcement clamps used for?

options.text: To hold the frame in the design position and provide the specified protective layer.
For temporary storage of cutting tools.
To change the steel grade on site.
For replacing all rod connections.
